name: mirage
text: Status: v1.0.115 (wallet figures from the Novig ledger on GitHub) is released. The engine's first full ledger read hit Novig's rate limit (it holds about 15,000 fill and settlement rows), so I'm fixing it to keep what it reads page by page, then building the Tracker's bets, daily P/L and charts on it as the one big release.
